verdict.rationale: The evidence describes rule-based automation, such as dynamic access rules, lifecycle automations and AI agents handling device logistics, plus paginated list endpoints in the API. None of it documents a bulk-operation capability for acting on many selected items at once. Automation policies and API pagination are adjacent features and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
